meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作短动态图形视频，如动效文字、数据动画、品牌标识动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成10秒内的动态图形视频，无需旁白或真人出镜
copy.tagline_en: Create short motion graphics like kinetic typography, data animations, and brand stings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce under-10s motion graphics without narration or live action

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述，自动生成一段短动画（如文字动效、数据图表、地图动画等），输出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一段简短、无旁白的动态图形（如片头、数据动画、地图高亮等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个数字从0数到100的动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个统计数字跳动动画。

say.text: 给这段文字做一个动态标题效果。
say.note: Claude 会生成动态文字动画。

say.text: 把这张地图上北京和上海连起来，并放大到北京。
say.note: Claude 会生成地图连线与缩放动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate a short motion graphic (e.g., kinetic typography, data chart, map animation) based on your description, outputting MP4 or transparent overlay video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short, narration-free motion graphic such as a title sequence, data animation, or map highlight.

say_en.text: Create an animation counting from 0 to 100.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a stat count-up animation.

say_en.text: Make a kinetic title effect for this text.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a kinetic typography animation.

say_en.text: Connect Beijing and Shanghai on this map and zoom to Beijing.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a map animation with connection and zoom.
